milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the cartography table and face it to demonstrate they have found it. The cartography table is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 4) inside the hut, with a second one at (6, 0, 2) outside. Target is set to (7, 1, 4) with max_distance=8 to allow detection from outside the hut entrance, and facing_tolerance=60 to confirm the player is looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the purple stained glass windows and face them. The purple stained glass blocks are at spawn-relative positions (13, 2, -5), (14, 2, -5), (12, 2, -3), and (15, 2, -3) in the stone brick building walls. Target is set to (13, 2, -4) as the approximate center of the glass cluster, with max_distance=10 to allow detection from outside the building entrance, and facing_tolerance=60 to confirm the player is looking toward the glass.
